safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports feeling hot/cold and sweaty, but has had no fevers.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated captures hot/cold sweats and that temperature was not measured, but does not document the Gold statement of 'no fevers.'
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document the patient’s statement of “no fevers” can skew clinical impression toward a febrile infectious process, potentially affecting diagnostic reasoning (e.g., pneumonia/flu) or follow-up urgency. However, the note still captures hot/cold sweats and that no temperature was measured, limiting the likelihood of major downstream mismanagement.
